```{r}
my_theme <- function() {
 theme(
    axis.title =element_text(size=12, angle = 0, color="black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust=0.5, size=12, angle = 40, color="black"),
    axis.text.y=element_text(size=12, hjust=1,  color="black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1,color="black"),
    axis.ticks.length= unit(0.1, "cm"),
    
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text=element_text(size=10, face = "bold"),
    
    panel.background=element_rect(fill="white", color="black"),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color="#CCCCCC", linetype = 2),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color="#CCCCCC", linetype = 2),
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16))
}
```

```{r}
#TImepoint lookup
Time_lookup <- tribble(
  ~Timepoint,    ~TIME,     ~TIME_VIS,    ~Timepoint_Clean,
  "Baseline",    -2,        -2,            "BL",
  "EOS",         -0.167,    -1,         "EOS",
  "EOR",          0,        -0.2,         "EOR",
  "1HR",          1,         0.6,          "1hr",
  "3HR",          3,         1.7,            "3hr",
  "6HR",          6,         3.2,          "6hr",
  "24HR",         24,        6,            "24hr"
)

df_Chrt <- read.csv(paste0(mypath, "/Data/analysis_ready_data/df_INVIVO_scenarioA.csv")) %>%
  left_join(Time_lookup, by= "Timepoint") %>% 
  mutate(Timepoint= coalesce(Timepoint_Clean, Timepoint)) %>%
  mutate(
    METRIC=gsub("bpm","Heart rate", METRIC),
    NAME=paste0(METRIC,"\n(",UNITS,")"),
    NAME=str_replace_all(NAME,c(
      "temp"         = "Temperature",
      "%_Free_Hb"    = "Free Hb",  
      "%_Free Hb"    = "Free Hb",
      "Free_Hb"      = "Free Hb",
      "HGB"          = "Hb",
      "CREA"         = "CR",
      "CKHR_time"    ="R.Time",
      "CKH_K"        ="K.Time",
      "R-Time"    ="R.Time",
      "K-Time"        ="K.Time",
      "CKH_angle"    ="Angle",
      "CKH_MA"       ="MA",
      "HCT\\s*\\(mmHg\\)" = "Hct\n(%)"
    )),
    
    #Clean up IDS
    ID=str_replace_all(ID,c("ID \\(" = "ARB ", "\\)" = ""))) %>% 
  arrange(
    match(MODEL, c("fWB","LR","sWB")),
    MODEL
  )
  
  df_Chrt <- df_Chrt %>%
    mutate(
      GROUP = case_when(
        GROUP %in% c("MAP", "Heart rate", "Body temp") ~ "Vitals",
        TRUE ~ GROUP
      )
    )
```

## Median, Range, Excel

### Seperate

```{r,eval= FALSE}
#Let's the user choose what to output
target_metric <- c("LAC")
target_timepoint <- c("BL","EOS")

df_filtered <- df_Chrt %>% 
  filter(Timepoint_Clean %in% target_timepoint,
         METRIC %in% target_metric)

#Function that does the heavy lifting
#Caculates the summary statistics and identifies outliers
get_summary_outliers <- function(data, timepoint){
  
  df_tp <- data %>% filter (Timepoint_Clean == timepoint)
  
  q25 <- quantile(df_tp$VALUE, 0.25, na.rm= TRUE)
  q75 <- quantile(df_tp$VALUE, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q75-q25
  
  #Summary Descriptive Statistics 
  summary_df <- df_tp %>% 
    group_by(Model = MODEL) %>% 
    summarise(
      Mean = round(Mean(VALUE, na.rm= TRUE),2),
      SD = round(sd(VALUE, na.rm= TRUE),2),
      Median = median(VALUE, na.rm= TRUE),
      IQR = q75-q25,
      Count = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  #Outliers detection
  iqr <- q75-q25
  
  lower_bound <- q25 - (3*iqr)
  upper_bound <- q75 + (3*iqr)
  
  outliers_df <- df_tp %>% 
    filter(VALUE < lower_bound | VALUE > upper_bound) %>% 
    select(ID, Value= VALUE)
  
  return(list(summary= summary_df, outliers = outliers_df))
}

#Assigns a dataframe for each timepoint of interest
for(t in target_timepoint){
  assign(paste0("df_",t) ,get_summary_outliers(df_filtered,t))
}

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, target_metric)

#Define Styles
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", border="bottom")
bold_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")

#Writes overall headers
writeData(wb, sheet= target_metric, x= target_metric, startCol=2, startRow = 2)

base_start_col <- 4
col_gap <- 8

for (i in seq_along(target_timepoint)){
  t <- target_timepoint[i]
  
  crt_data <- get(paste0("df_",t))
  
  summary_col <- base_start_col + (i-1)*col_gap
  header_col <- summary_col -1
  
  #writes timepoint header
  writeData(wb, sheet = target_metric, x=t, startCol = header_col, startRow = 3, headerStyle = bold_style)
  writeData(wb, sheet = target_metric, x = crt_data$summary, startCol = summary_col, startRow = 4, headerStyle = header_style)
  
  #Puts the outlier row below the usmmary
  outlier_row <- 4+ nrow(crt_data$summary) + 2
  
  #Outlier header
  writeData(wb, sheet = target_metric, x="Outliers:", startCol = summary_col, startRow= outlier_row, headerStyle=bold_style)
  
  writeData(wb, sheet=target_metric, x= nrow(crt_data$outliers), startCol = summary_col+1, startRow= outlier_row)
  
  if(nrow(crt_data$outliers) >0){
    writeData(wb, sheet=target_metric, x=crt_data$outliers, startCol=summary_col, startRow= outlier_row +1, headerStyle = header_style)
  }else{
    writeData(wb, sheet= target_metric, x= data.frame(Model=character(), Value=numeric()), startCol=summary_col, startRow= outlier_row +1, headerStyle=header_style)
  }
  
}
DesStats_excel <- paste0(CSV_files,"/df_Seperate_DesStats.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb,DesStats_excel,overwrite=TRUE)
```

### Combined Excel

```{r}
#Let's the user choose what to output
target_metric_cb <- c("LAC", "pH", "pO2", "pCO2")
target_timepoint_cb <- c("BL","EOS")

df_filtered_cb <- df_Chrt %>% 
  filter(Timepoint_Clean %in% target_timepoint_cb,
         METRIC %in% target_metric_cb)

#Function that does the heavy lifting
#Caculates the summary statistics and identifies outliers
get_summary_outliers_cb <- function(data, timepoint){
  
  df_tp<- data %>% filter (Timepoint_Clean == timepoint)

  
  #Prevents errors if a timepoint is absolutely empty 
  if(nrow(df_tp) ==0){
    summary_empty <- data.frame(`Combined Model`=character(), Mean=numeric(), SD=numeric(), Median=numeric(), IQR=numeric(), Q1=numeric(), Q3=numeric(), Count=integer(), check.names=FALSE)
    outlier_empty <- data.frame(ID=character(), Variable=character(), Value=numeric())
    return(list(summary = summary_empty, outliers = outlier_empty))
  }
  #Summary Descriptive Statistics 
  summary_df <- df_tp %>% 
    group_by(`Combined Model` = METRIC) %>% 
    summarise(
      Mean = round(Mean(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      SD = round(sd(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Median = median(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR = round(IQR(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
      Q1= round(quantile(VALUE, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
      Q3  =round(quantile(VALUE, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
      Count = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) 
  
  #Outliers detection
  outliers_df <- df_tp %>% 
    group_by(METRIC) %>%
    mutate(
      q25 = quantile(VALUE, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(VALUE, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_val = q75 - q25,
      lower_bound = q25 - (3 * iqr_val),
      upper_bound = q75 + (3 * iqr_val)
    ) %>%
    filter(VALUE < lower_bound | VALUE > upper_bound) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(METRIC,MODEL) %>% 
    select(-MODEL) %>% 
    select(ID, Variable = METRIC, Value = VALUE)
  
  return(list(summary = summary_df, outliers = outliers_df))
}

#Excel Generating logic
wb <- createWorkbook()

#Define Styles
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", border="bottom")
bold_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")

generate_sheet <- function(wb, sheet_name, data, timepoints_to_Process){

addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  
base_start_col <- 4
col_gap <- 9

for (i in seq_along(timepoints_to_Process)){
  t <- timepoints_to_Process[i]
  
  crt_data <- get_summary_outliers_cb(data, t)

  summary_col <- base_start_col + (i - 1) * col_gap
  header_col <- summary_col - 1
  
  # Writes timepoint header
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = t, startCol = header_col, startRow = 3, headerStyle = bold_style)
  
  # Writes summary table (if it exists)
  if(nrow(crt_data$summary)>0){
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = crt_data$summary, startCol = summary_col, startRow = 4, headerStyle = header_style)
  }
  
  # Puts the outlier row below the summary
  sum_rows <- if(nrow(crt_data$summary)>0) nrow(crt_data$summary) else 1
  outlier_row <- 4 + sum_rows + 2
  
  # Outlier header
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = "Outliers:", startCol = summary_col, startRow = outlier_row, headerStyle = bold_style)
  
  # Outlier count (placed a couple of columns over to match image format)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = nrow(crt_data$outliers), startCol = summary_col + 1, startRow = outlier_row)
  
  # Outlier table
  if(nrow(crt_data$outliers) > 0){
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = crt_data$outliers, startCol = summary_col, startRow = outlier_row + 1, headerStyle = header_style)
  } else {
    # Fills an empty frame with matching headers if no outliers exist
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = data.frame(ID = character(), Variable = character(), Vlue = numeric()), startCol = summary_col, startRow = outlier_row + 1, headerStyle = header_style)
  }
 }
}

#Generates the initial sheet
generate_sheet(
  wb=wb,
  sheet_name="Targeted Variables",
  data= df_filtered_cb,
  timepoints_to_Process = target_timepoint_cb
)

#Generates the remaining sheets

groups <- unique(df_Chrt[["GROUP"]])
groups <- groups[!is.na(groups)] #Removes NAs

for (grp in groups){
  df_group<- df_Chrt %>% filter (!!sym("GROUP") == grp)
  
  group_timepoints <- c("BL","EOS","EOR","1hr","3hr","6hr","24hr")
  
  clean_grp <- as.character(grp)
  
  clean_grp <- gsub("[:% ]+", "_", clean_grp)
  clean_grp <- gsub("'s","s",clean_grp)
  
  sheet_title <- substr(paste0(clean_grp),1,31)
  
  generate_sheet(
    wb=wb,
    sheet_name = sheet_title,
    data= df_group,
    timepoints_to_Process = group_timepoints
  )
}

DesStats_Combined_excel <- paste0(CSV_files,"/df_Combined_DesStats.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, DesStats_Combined_excel, overwrite=TRUE)
```

### Plots Setup
```{r}
plot_func <- function(data, vec, file, facet_labels = NULL) {
  
  make_plot <- function(df_temp, save_prefix, vjust_mult) {
    
    df_temp <- df_temp %>%
      filter(NAME %in% vec) %>%
      mutate(
        NAME_F = factor(NAME, levels = vec),
        model_index = as.numeric(factor(MODEL, levels = vec_breaks)),
        VJUST = vjust_mult * model_index
      )
    
    facet_part <- facet_wrap2(
      ~NAME_F,
      scales = "free_y",
      strip.position = "left",
      labeller = if (is.null(facet_labels)) {
        label_value
      } else {
        as_labeller(facet_labels, default = label_value)
      }
    )
    
    p <- ggplot(df_temp, aes(x = TIME_VIS, y = Mean, color = factor(MODEL))) +
      facet_part +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_text(
        aes(x = TIME_VIS, y = Inf, label = N, color = MODEL, vjust = VJUST),
        size = 2,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD),
        width = 0.1,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = TIME_VIS, 
      labels = time_levels
       ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = pretty_breaks(),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.4))
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        breaks = vec_breaks,
        values = vec_colors,
        labels = vec_labels
      ) +
      labs(x = "", y = "", color = "") +
      theme_minimal() +
      my_theme() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 8, color = "black"),
        strip.text.y.left = element_markdown(size = 14, face = "bold", angle = 90, lineheight = 1.1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
    
    ggsave(
      paste0(Single_graphs, "/", save_prefix, "_", file, date, ".png"),
      p,
      width = 11,
      height = 6,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 600
    )
  }
  
  if (any(grepl("SAC", vec_breaks))) {
    df_temp_SAC <- data %>% filter(!grepl("WBA", MODEL))
    make_plot(df_temp_SAC, "SAC", 1)
  }
  
  if (any(grepl("WBA", vec_breaks))) {
    df_temp_WBA <- data %>% filter(!grepl("SAC", MODEL))
    make_plot(df_temp_WBA, "WBA", 1.4)
  }
}
```

## Graphing

### Line Plots
```{r,warning=FALSE}

plot_func_facet_p <- function(data, vec, facet_labels = NULL, vjust_mult = 1,n) {
  
  df_temp <- data %>%
    filter(NAME %in% vec) %>%
    mutate(
      NAME_F = factor(NAME, levels = vec),
      model_index = as.numeric(factor(MODEL, levels = vec_breaks)),
      VJUST = vjust_mult * model_index
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(df_temp, aes(x = TIME_VIS, y = Mean, color = factor(MODEL))) +
    
    ggh4x::facet_wrap2(
      ~NAME_F,
      ncol = n,
      scales = "free_y",
      strip.position = "left",
      labeller = if (is.null(facet_labels)) label_value else as_labeller(facet_labels),
      strip = ggh4x::strip_vanilla(size = "constant")
    ) +
    
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    
    geom_errorbar(
  aes(ymin = Mean - SD,ymax = Mean + SD,color = factor(MODEL)),
  width = 0.3,
  linewidth = 0.6
) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = TIME_VIS, 
      labels = time_levels,
      expand = expansion(add = c(0.18, 0.22))
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = pretty_breaks(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(
      breaks = vec_breaks,
      values = vec_colors,
      labels = vec_labels
    ) +
    
    labs(x = "", y = "", color = "") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal() +
    my_theme() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_markdown(
        hjust = 1, vjust = 1.2, size = 11, color = "black",angle=65),
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold",
        angle = 90,
        lineheight = 1,
        margin= margin(r=2)),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.box = "horizontal",
  legend.box.just = "center",
      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 16, 12, 1)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

add_facet_letters <- function(p,
                              labels = LETTERS,
                              x_off = unit(0, "lines"),
                              y_off = unit(0.18, "lines"),
                              fontsize = 24) {
  
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  
  panel_id <- grep("^panel", g$layout$name)
  panel_layout <- g$layout[panel_id, ]
  
  n_panels <- nrow(panel_layout)
  labs <- labels[seq_len(n_panels)]
  

  for (i in seq_len(n_panels)) {
    
    #Caculates the index to avoid unit subsetting
    idx_x <- (i-1) %% length(x_off) + 1
    idx_y <- (i-1) %% length(y_off) + 1
    
    g <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(
      g,
      grobs = grid::textGrob(
        labs[i],
        
        # Safety recycled index
        x = unit(0, "npc") - x_off[idx_x],
        y = unit(1, "npc") + y_off[idx_y],
        just = c("center", "center"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fontsize, fontface = "bold")
      ),
      t = panel_layout$t[i],
      l = panel_layout$l[i],
      clip = "off",
      name = paste0("facet-letter-", i)
    )
  }
  
  return(g)
}
```

### Boxplots
```{r, warning= FALSE}

plot_func_comb_bp <- function(data,vec, facet_labels= NULL, vjust_multi=1, n){
  
  df_temp <- data %>% 
    filter(NAME %in% vec) %>% 
    mutate(
      NAME_F = factor(NAME, levels = vec),
      model_index = as.numeric(factor(MODEL,levels = vec_breaks)),
      VJust= vjust_multi * model_index
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(df_temp, aes(x= TIME_VIS, y= VALUE, color= factor(MODEL)))+
    
   facet_wrap2(
      ~NAME_F,
      ncol = n,
      scales = "free_y",
      strip.position = "left",
      labeller = if (is.null(facet_labels)) label_value else as_labeller(facet_labels),
      strip = ggh4x::strip_vanilla(size = "constant")
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group= interaction(TIME_VIS, MODEL)),
      linewidth= 0.6,
      width =0.6,
      outlier.size = 1,
      position = position_dodge(width= 0.8) #Keeps models from overlapping
    )+
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = TIME_VIS, 
      labels = time_levels,
      expand = expansion(add = c(0.18, 0.22))
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = pretty_breaks(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(
      breaks = vec_breaks,
      values = vec_colors,
      labels = vec_labels
    ) +
    
    labs(x = "", y = "", color = "") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal() +
    my_theme() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_markdown(
        hjust = 1, vjust = 1.2, size = 11, color = "black",angle=65),
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold",
        angle = 90,
        lineheight = 1,
        margin= margin(r=2)),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.box.just = "center",
      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 16, 12, 1)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

add_facet_letters <- function(p,
                              labels = LETTERS,
                              x_off = unit(0, "lines"),
                              y_off = unit(0.18, "lines"),
                              fontsize = 24) {
  
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  
  panel_id <- grep("^panel", g$layout$name)
  panel_layout <- g$layout[panel_id, ]
  
  n_panels <- nrow(panel_layout)
  labs <- labels[seq_len(n_panels)]
  

  for (i in seq_len(n_panels)) {
    
    #Caculates the index to avoid unit subsetting
    idx_x <- (i-1) %% length(x_off) + 1
    idx_y <- (i-1) %% length(y_off) + 1
    
    g <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(
      g,
      grobs = grid::textGrob(
        labs[i],
        
        # Safety recycled index
        x = unit(0, "npc") - x_off[idx_x],
        y = unit(1, "npc") + y_off[idx_y],
        just = c("center", "center"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = fontsize, fontface = "bold")
      ),
      t = panel_layout$t[i],
      l = panel_layout$l[i],
      clip = "off",
      name = paste0("facet-letter-", i)
    )
  }
  
  return(g)
}
```

### N-Count Excel Sheet 
```{r}
#Function for master sheet

Write_Master_Count <- function(wb, sheet_name, data_n, time_levels, models, mod_lab){
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  
  #Styles Used for master sheet
  group_style <- createStyle(fontName = "Aptos Narrow", fgFill= "#F4B084", border= "TopBottomLeftRight")
  
  var_style <- createStyle( fontName = "Aptos Narrow", fgFill="#A9D08E", border= "TopBottomLeftRight",halign="center")
  
  table_style <- createStyle(fontName = "Aptos Narrow", border="TopBottomLeftRight", halign="center")
  
  bold_style <- createStyle(fontName = "Aptos Narrow", textDecoration = "bold")
  Total_top_line <- createStyle (border= "Top", borderStyle = "medium")
  
  #Starting Row
  current_row <- 2
  
  #Gets unqiue Groups
  groups <- unique(data_n$GROUP)
  groups <- groups[groups %in% c("ABG", "CBC", "CMP", "MAP", "TEG 5000")]
  
  for (grp in groups){
    #Writes Group name First
    writeData(wb, sheet_name, grp, startCol=2, startRow= current_row)
    addStyle(wb, sheet_name, group_style, rows= current_row, cols=2)
    
    #Filters data for only that group
    grp_data <- data_n %>%  filter(GROUP == grp)
    
    #Gets unique variables for the group
    metrics <- unique(grp_data$METRIC)
    
    #Reset starting column for varaibles (col 3 = C)
    current_col <- 3
    max_table_height <- 0 #finds tallest table in group, use for next group
    
    for (met in metrics){
      #Writes Variable Name
      var_row<- current_row +2
      writeData(wb, sheet_name, met, startCol= current_col, startRow= var_row)
      addStyle(wb, sheet_name, var_style, rows= var_row, cols= current_col)
      
      #Space between variable and Table
      table_row <- var_row +1
      table_col <- current_col +0
      
      #Wrangles Table Data
      #i.e. pivots and caculates totals
      tbl_data <- grp_data %>% 
        filter(METRIC == met) %>% 
        group_by(MODEL, Timepoint) %>% 
        summarise(Total_N = sum(N, na.rm= TRUE), .groups="drop") %>% 
        mutate(Timepoint= factor(Timepoint, levels= time_levels, labels= time_levels)) %>% 
        mutate(MODEL = factor(MODEL, levels= models, labels=mod_lab)) %>% 
        complete(MODEL, Timepoint, fill = list(Total_N = 0)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from= Total_N, values_fill=0, names_sort= TRUE)

      
      #Caculates column Totals 
      total_row <- tbl_data %>% 
        summarise(across(where(is.numeric),~sum(., na.rm= TRUE))) %>% 
        mutate(MODEL= "Total") %>% 
        relocate(MODEL)
      
      #Binds totals and makes first column blank
      tbl_data <- bind_rows(tbl_data, total_row) %>% 
        rename(" "= MODEL)
      
      #Writes the table
      table_row <- current_row +3
      writeData(wb, sheet_name, tbl_data, startCol= table_col, startRow= table_row)
      
      total_row_idx <- table_row + nrow (tbl_data)
      total_col_idx <- table_col + ncol (tbl_data) -1
      
      #Applies grid borders
      addStyle(wb, sheet_name, table_style,
               rows= table_row:total_row_idx,
               cols= table_col:total_col_idx,
               gridExpand = TRUE, stack= TRUE)
      
      #Applies Total Column bolding
      addStyle(wb, sheet_name, bold_style,
               rows= total_row_idx, cols = table_col:total_col_idx,
               gridExpand = TRUE, stack= TRUE)
      
      
      addStyle(wb, sheet_name, Total_top_line,
               rows= total_row_idx,
               cols= table_col:total_col_idx,
               gridExpand = TRUE, stack= TRUE)
      
      #Tracks height to position the next group
      max_table_height <- max (max_table_height, total_row_idx - current_row)
      #Uppdates column position (With 1 extra empty space)
      current_col <- total_col_idx + 2
    }
    
    #updates row positon for next group
    current_row <- current_row+ max_table_height+ 2
  }
}

#Counts for combined and indvidual models
Writes_Count_Tables<- function (wb,sheet_name, data_n){
  addWorksheet(wb,sheet_name)
  
  #Creates custom style to highlight group name
  group_style<-createStyle(fontName="Aptos Narrow",fgFill = "#F2CEEF", halign="center",valign="center")
  header_style<-createStyle(fontName="Aptos Narrow",border="Bottom",halign="left")
  metric_style<-createStyle(fontName="Aptos Narrow",border="Right",halign="left")
  data_style<-createStyle(fontName="Aptos Narrow",halign="left")
  intersection_style<-createStyle(border="BottomRight")
  
  #Starting row
  current_row<-2
  
  #Gets unique group names
  groups<-unique(data_n$GROUP)
  groups<-groups[groups %in% c("ABG", "CBC", "CMP", "MAP", "TEG 5000")]
  
  for (grp in groups){
    
    #Writes Group's data
    writeData(wb,sheet_name,grp,startCol = 2,startRow = current_row)
    addStyle(wb, sheet_name,group_style,rows=current_row,cols=2)
    
    #Skips a row for spacing
    table_row<-current_row +2
    table_col<-3
    
    #Pivots to wideformat
    grp_data<-data_n %>% 
      filter(GROUP == grp) %>%
      #Factors TimePoints
      mutate(Timepoint=factor(Timepoint,levels=time_levels,labels=time_levels)) %>%
      arrange(Timepoint) %>% 
      select(-GROUP) %>% #Since "GROUP" is the title, remove it
      pivot_wider(names_from=Timepoint,values_from=Total_N,names_sort=TRUE) %>% 
      rename(" "=METRIC) #Renaming Metric to blank to stop header from appearing in table
    
    #Writes data to pivoted data table
    writeData(wb,sheet_name,grp_data,startCol = table_col,startRow = table_row)
    
    #Applying header style
    if(ncol(grp_data)>1){
      addStyle(wb,sheet_name,header_style, rows=table_row, cols=(table_col+1):(table_col+ncol(grp_data)-1), gridExpand=TRUE)
    }
    
    #Applys intersection formatting
    addStyle(wb,sheet_name,intersection_style, rows=table_row,cols=table_col,gridExpand = TRUE)
    
    #Formatting columns below the header
    #Formatting metric column
    if(nrow(grp_data)>0){
      addStyle(wb,sheet_name,metric_style,
               rows=(table_row+1):(table_row+nrow(grp_data)),
               cols=table_col,gridExpand=TRUE)
      
      #Formatting numbers
      if(nrow(grp_data)>1){
        addStyle(wb,sheet_name,data_style,
          rows=(table_row+1):(table_row+nrow(grp_data)),
          cols=(table_col+1):(table_col+ncol(grp_data)-1),gridExpand = TRUE)    
      }
    }
    
    #Updates current row for next group's table
    current_row<-table_row+nrow(grp_data)+2
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.show = 'hide',message= FALSE, warning=FALSE}
            MIN=min(VALUE, na.rm=T), MED=quantile(VALUE, probs=0.5, na.rm=T), MAX=max(VALUE, na.rm=T),

calc_auc <- function(x,y,end) {
  sorted_df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y) %>% filter(x <= end, !is.na(y)) %>% arrange(x)
  auc <- trapz(sorted_df$x, sorted_df$y)
  return(auc)
}
```

```{r}
plot_func_facet <- function(data, vec, file, facet_labels = NULL, vjust_mult = 1.4,n) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtext)
  library(scales)
  library(ggh4x)
  
  df_panel_letters <- data.frame(
    NAME_F = factor(vec, levels = vec),
    LETTER = LETTERS[seq_along(vec)],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  df_temp <- data %>%
    filter(NAME %in% vec) %>%
    mutate(
      NAME_F = factor(NAME, levels = vec),
      model_index = as.numeric(factor(MODEL, levels = vec_breaks)),
      VJUST = vjust_mult * model_index
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(df_temp, aes(x = TIME_VIS, y = MEAN, color = factor(MODEL))) +
    
    ggh4x::facet_wrap2(
      ~NAME_F,
      ncol = NULL,
      scales = "free_y",
      strip.position = "left",
      labeller = if (is.null(facet_labels)) {
        label_value
      } else {
        as_labeller(facet_labels)
      }
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = df_panel_letters,
      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = LETTER),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 4,
      vjust = 1.15,
      size = 6,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    
    # geom_text(
    #   aes(x = TIME_VIS, y = Inf, label = N, color = MODEL, vjust = VJUST),
    #   size = 2,
    #   show.legend = FALSE
    # ) +
    
    # geom_errorbar(
    #   aes(ymin = MEAN - SD, ymax = MEAN + SD),
    #   width = 0.1,
    #   color = "black"
    # ) +
    
    geom_errorbar(
  aes(ymin = MEAN - SD,ymax = MEAN + SD,color = factor(MODEL)),
  width = 0.2,
  linewidth = 0.6
) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = TIME_VIS, 
      labels = time_levels,
      expand = expansion(add = c(0.18, 0.22))
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = pretty_breaks(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(
      breaks = vec_breaks,
      values = vec_colors,
      labels = vec_labels
    ) +
    
    labs(x = "", y = "", color = "") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    my_theme() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_markdown(
        hjust = 1, vjust = 1.2, size = 8, color = "black",angle=65),
      strip.text.y.left = element_markdown(
  size = 11,
  face = "bold",
  angle = 90,
  lineheight = 1,
  margin = margin(r = 2)   
),
      legend.position = "top",
panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"),
#panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"),
      #plot.margin = margin(20, 12, 12, 15),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  ggsave(
    paste0(Combined_graphs, "/FACET_", file, date, ".png"),
    p,
    width = 11,
    height = 6,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  return(p)
}
```

### Time-To-Recovery Analysis
```{r}

df_change <- df_plt %>% 
  filter(METRIC == "MAP" | METRIC == "LAC") %>%
  arrange(NAME, MODEL, ID, TIME) %>%
  select(METRIC, NAME, MODEL, ID, TIME, Timepoint, VALUE) %>% 
  group_by(METRIC, MODEL, ID) %>%
  mutate(CHANGE = (VALUE - VALUE[1L])) %>%
  ungroup()

df_change_peak <- df_change %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "EOS") %>%
  mutate(PEAK80 = CHANGE*0.2) %>%
  arrange(METRIC, MODEL, ID) %>%
  select(METRIC, MODEL, ID, PEAK80) %>%
  full_join(df_change, by = c("METRIC", "MODEL", "ID")) 


df_cross <- df_change_peak %>% 
  filter(Timepoint!="BL") %>%
  group_by(METRIC, NAME, MODEL, ID) %>%
  mutate(difference = CHANGE - PEAK80,
         lag_difference = lag(difference),
         lag_time = lag(TIME),
         crossing = difference * lag_difference <= 0 & !is.na(lag_difference)) %>%
  mutate(T_CROSS = TIME - difference / (difference - lag_difference) * (TIME - lag_time)) %>%
  filter(crossing | (!any(crossing) & row_number() == 1)) %>%  # Retain rows with crossing or a single placeholder if no crossing
  slice(1) %>%  # Take the first crossing or placeholder row per group
  mutate(CENSORED = if_else(is.na(T_CROSS), "YES", "NO")) %>%
  left_join(df_last_time, by = c("ID","METRIC")) %>%
  filter(LAST_TIME == 24) %>% # Removing rabbits that died early since it inaccurately pulls down the mean time to recovery
  mutate(T_CROSS = if_else(is.na(T_CROSS), LAST_TIME, T_CROSS)) %>%
  select(METRIC, NAME, MODEL, ID, PEAK80, T_CROSS, CENSORED)
  
df_quant_cross <- df_cross %>% 
  group_by(NAME, MODEL) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(QUANT25 = quantile(T_CROSS, probs = 0.25, na.rm=T), QUANT75 = quantile(T_CROSS, probs = 0.75, na.rm=T)) %>%
  mutate(IQR = abs(QUANT75-QUANT25)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(NAME, MODEL)

df_cross_cleaned <- df_cross %>% left_join(df_quant_cross) %>%
  mutate(OUTLIER = if_else(T_CROSS > QUANT75 + 3 * IQR | T_CROSS < QUANT25 - 3 * IQR, "YES", "NO"))%>%
  mutate(METHOD = "CROSS")

df_cross_stats_cleaned <- df_cross_cleaned %>%
  filter(OUTLIER == "NO") %>% group_by(METHOD,METRIC, MODEL) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(MEAN = mean(T_CROSS), SD = sd(T_CROSS), n = n(), .groups = "keep") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(NAME = paste0(METRIC, "\n %Change from EOS")) 


write.csv(df_cross_cleaned, paste0(CSV_files, "/df_cross_cleaned", date,".csv"), row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r,eval= FALSE}
# Create an ES df for "MODEL vs LR"
make_es_df <- function(df_wide, model, measure) {
  mean_model <- paste0("MEAN_", model)
  df_wide %>%
    mutate(
      ES = (.data[[mean_model]] - .data[["MEAN_Combined"]]) / .data[["SD_Combined"]],
      VJUST = ifelse(ES > 0, -0.3, 1.5),
      MEASURE = measure) %>%
    select(METRIC, TIMERANGE, ES, VJUST, MEASURE)
}

plot_ES_relAUC_LAC <- plot_ES_relAUC("LAC")
```

### Effect Size Analysis (Recovery Time)

```{r,eval= FALSE}

df_wide_cross <- df_cross_stats_cleaned %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(METRIC),
    names_from = MODEL,
    names_glue = "{.value}_{MODEL}",
    values_from = c(MEAN, SD, n)
  )

make_es_df <- function(df_wide, model, label) {
  mean_model <- paste0("MEAN_", model)
  df_wide %>% mutate(
      ES = (.data[[mean_model]] - .data[["MEAN_Combined"]]) / .data[["SD_Combined"]],
      VJUST = ifelse(ES > 0, -0.3, 1.5),
      MEASURE = label,
      CATEGORY = label) %>%
    select(METRIC, ES, VJUST, MEASURE, CATEGORY)
}

margin <- c(0, 30, 20, 10)

df_TPP_cross <- make_es_df(df_wide_cross, model = "Combined", label = "TPP")

df_ES_cross_margins <- map_dfr(margin, ~ df_TPP_cross %>% mutate(
  MEASURE  = if_else(.x == 0, "TPP", paste0(.x, "% margin")),
  CATEGORY = "TPP",
  ES = ES - ES * (.x / 100),
  VJUST = ifelse(ES > 0, -0.3, 1.5)))

df_models_cross <- map2_dfr(vec_breaks_NI, vec_labels_NI, ~ make_es_df(df_wide_cross, model = .x, label = .y))

df_ES_cross_margins <- bind_rows(df_ES_cross_margins, df_models_cross)
write.csv(df_ES_cross_margins, paste0(CSV_files, "/Rabbit_cross_ES.csv"))

df_check_cross_margins <- df_ES_cross_margins %>% 
  group_by(METRIC) %>%
  mutate(CHECK = case_when(
      CATEGORY== "TPP" ~ "-",
      ES < ES[2L] ~ "✔",
      #ES < ES[3L]+0.1 & ES > ES[3L] ~ "✔",
      ES > ES[2L] ~ "x",
      T  ~ "-"),
    color = case_when(
      CATEGORY== "TPP" ~  "white",
      ES < ES[2L] ~ "green3",
      #ES < ES[3L]+0.1 & ES > ES[3L] ~ "gold",
      ES > ES[2L] ~ "red",
      T ~ "white"),
    VJUST_CHECK = 2) %>%
  arrange(METRIC)


plot_ES_tcross <- function(metric){
  plot_ES_tcross_temp <- df_ES_cross_margins %>% filter(METRIC==metric) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(MEASURE,
                          levels = c("TPP","30% margin","20% margin","10% margin", vec_labels_NI)), 
               y = ES, fill = CATEGORY)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", ES), vjust = VJUST), color = "black", size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    geom_text(data = filter(df_check_cross_margins, METRIC==metric), aes(label = CHECK, color = color, vjust = VJUST_CHECK, 
                                              group = factor(MEASURE, levels = c("TPP", "30% Margin", vec_labels_NI))), 
                  size = 4, fontface = "bold", 
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    my_theme2()+
    
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TPP"= "#0072B5FF", vec_colors_NI),
                      limits = c("TPP", names(vec_colors_NI)))+
    scale_color_manual(values= c( "red"="red", "gold"="gold", "green3"="green3", "white"="white")) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.4, 0.1))) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("TPP","30% margin","20% margin",
    "10% margin",names(vec_colors_NI)))+
    labs(title="Time to\n80% Recovery", x = "", y="Effect Size\n\u00A0") +
    guides(color = "none") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          text = element_text(family = "sans"))
  
   ggsave(paste0(Single_graphs, "/plot_ES_tcross_", metric, date,".png"), plot_ES_tcross_temp, width=4, height=3, units = "in", dpi=600)
  return(plot_ES_tcross_temp)
}

plot_ES_tcross_MAP <- plot_ES_tcross("MAP")
plot_ES_tcross_LAC <- plot_ES_tcross("LAC")
```
